description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build, run and support dependable services for a software platform deployed in customer environments. Partner with field and product engineers on design, automation and production support, including a share of on-call coverage.
 What you'll do
 - Run and support deployed software, covering health monitoring, alerts, settings management and version upgrades.
 - Roll out new products at customer sites and move existing deployments onto newer infrastructure.
 - Investigate and tune services and underlying infrastructure so they stay stable and can grow over time.
 - Replace repetitive manual work with automation, scripts and runbooks.
 - Diagnose production incidents and restore service quickly with limited disruption.
 - Join a rotating on-call support schedule.
 - Work with field and product teams on sound, scalable system design.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Strong Java skills.
 - Current U.S. security clearance at Secret level or above; clearances that are lapsed, expired or still in process do not qualify.
 - Experience shipping and running production systems, not only troubleshooting them.
 - Comfort solving coding problems in real time and structuring a problem into logical steps.
 - Hands-on production experience with containers and orchestration platforms.
 - Experience in defense technology or another technically demanding organization.
 - A bachelor's-level degree in computer science, computer engineering or a closely related field, with solid grounding in the fundamentals.
 - No interview with the company in the past 12 months.
 Bonus points
 - Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time.
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools or CI/CD pipelines.
 - Degree from a highly ranked university.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 135,000 to 200,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Life and disability insurance
 - Retirement plan
 - Paid time off and holidays
 - Parental leave and family benefits
 - Relocation assistance
 Location and work model
 - Honolulu, HI, United States
 - Hybrid
 - Full-time
